property_summary: Whenever an order is filled, the taker (msg.sender) must become the owner of the newly minted opposite-position token (ownerOf(positionId) == msg.sender, never the zero address); the mutant assigns address(0) on mint, so ownerOf(positionId) reverts/returns zero for some fuzzed order.
change_summary: Mint assigns the zero address as owner instead of the recipient.
